## About
Bayliss Tire & Auto Clinic is an independent, full-service repair shop in the heart of Clawson, Michigan. We handle major and minor repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles, from everyday drivers to classics.
Our ASE and State certified master technicians look your car over from bumper to bumper, and Troy will walk you through what was done. One reviewer said Troy came out and explained everything he repaired. Another said we are honest and only replace what's needed.
We like being part of this town. We sponsor the Clawson Lions Club Car Show, Forgotten Harvest, Compassion International, Leader Dogs for the Blind, Veterans of America and American Legion, and we also donate cars.

## Services
- Major engine repair: Service engine soon light on? We diagnose the problem and handle major engine repairs and replacements.
- Brakes and ABS systems: Brake work and ABS diagnosis for foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Oil changes: Oil and filter changes to keep your engine running well, with courtesy safety inspections.
- Radiator repairs and rebuilds: We repair and rebuild radiators.
- Front end and steering: Front end and steering work from a technician who specializes in it.
- Towing and emergency service: If your car won't start, we can tow it in. One reviewer said we towed his car and fixed it quickly.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us or send a repair request through the site and we'll get you a free estimate.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service both foreign and domestic vehicles, including new, old and classic cars.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. Use our after-hours drop box and we'll take it from there.

Q: Do you offer fleet discounts?
A: We do. If you have a fleet of vehicles, give us a call and ask.
